questions.explanation:
Why This Is Asked
Tests integration of image provenance with runtime attestation in a multi-tenant CNF environment, plus policy automation and rollback

## Key Concepts
- Image provenance (Cosign + SBOM)
- Runtime attestation (TPM/measured boot)
- Kubernetes admission controls (Kyverno/OPA)
- Per-tenant isolation and testability
- Canary rollout and rollback

## Code Example
```bash
# Sign and attest
cosign sign -key kms-key.pem docker.io/org/cnf:tag
cosign attest docker.io/org/cnf:tag --attestation-file attestation.yaml
```
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-cnf-provenance-runtime
spec:
  rules:
  - name: attest-and-sbom-check
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Deployment"]
    validate:
      message: "Containers must carry cnf.io/attested and cnf.io/sbom annotations"
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            metadata:
              annotations:
                cnf.io/attested: "?*"
                cnf.io/sbom: "?*"
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test attestation failure paths and rollbacks?
- How to rotate tenant-specific attestation keys without downtime?

This question probes practical rollout discipline, end-to-end image provenance, and tenant isolation during CNF upgrades. It requires concrete mechanisms for per‑tenant traffic shaping, SBOM enforcement, and reliable rollback in production.

- Canary deployments with tenant segmentation
- Image provenance with Cosign signing and SBOM validation

```yaml

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway-canary
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-cluster, tenant-isolated config rollouts with dynamic proxy configuration.

## Key Concepts
- Envoy xDS dynamic configuration and Aggregated Discovery Service (ADS)
- Kubernetes CRD-based policy model per tenant with isolation
- Canary traffic shaping with weight and time-based rollout window
- Multi-cluster consistency and safe rollback mechanisms
- Observability hooks for validation during rollout phases

## Code Example
```yaml
# (a) Tenant Routing Policy with Canary Weight and Rollout Window
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantRoutePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api-v2
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenant: tenant-a
  targetCluster: cluster-west
  route:
    path: /api/v2
    backendRefs:
      - name: gateway-service
        port: 8080
  canary:
    weight: 0  # Start at 0%
    rolloutDuration: 30m
    stepWeight: 10  # Increment by 10% each step
    stepInterval: 5m
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: 5  # Rollback if 5 consecutive errors exceed threshold
    errorRateThreshold: 0.05  # 5% error rate triggers rollback
  healthCheck:
    endpoint: /healthz
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
---
# (b) Sidecar Config to Watch Policy and Push Updates
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway-sidecar
  namespace: gateway-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: xds-controller
          image: cnf/xds-controller:latest
          args:
            - --policy-namespace=tenant-a
            - --xds-address=$(POD_IP):18000
            - --sync-interval=10s
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: policy-config
              mountPath: /etc/policy
              readOnly: true
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:latest
          args:
            - --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml
            - --service-cluster gateway
          volumeMounts:
            - name: envoy-config
              mountPath: /etc/envoy
      volumes:
        - name: policy-config
          configMap:
            name: tenant-policies
        - name: envoy-config
          emptyDir: {}
---
# (c) One-Namespace Test Manifest for Canary Rollout and Rollback
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: CanaryRolloutTest
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: tenant-a-api-v2
  testStages:
    - stage: baseline
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 0
      checks:
        - type: metrics
          metric: requests_total{path="/api/v2"}
          condition: equals 0
    - stage: canary_10pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 10
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/health
          expectSuccessRate: 0.95
        - type: metrics
          metric: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{cluster="backend-v2"}
          condition: exists
    - stage: canary_50pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 50
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/users
          expectSuccessRate: 0.99
    - stage: full_rollout
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 100
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/**
          expectSuccessRate: 0.999
  rollbackTest:
```
